title: Aromatic Smoky Jamaican Chicken Stew
description: A dense and adventurous Jamaican dish featuring smoky flavors and red wine vinegar, cooked in a papillote for a unique twist, this stew is perfect for those looking for a nut-free friendly meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, smoked paprika, and thyme.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium high heat and sear the chicken until browned on all sides.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the scotch bonnet peppers, red wine vinegar, and chicken broth to the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot with a piece of parchment paper, creating a papillote, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the parchment paper and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
